verdicts.reason: A pulls all the text out of the label frame and leaves it empty except for stray divider rules, shrinks the illustration row to a tiny strip at the middle, and leaves the bottom ~40% of the canvas dead, so the hero imagery is lost. B also leaves an empty white label box floating mid-canvas and scrambles the reading order ('J'adore Paris' now sits below 'Homemade Lotion', with 'Skincare' detached). Its illustrations are scattered, but they are larger, the text is readable, and the lavender sketch feel comes through, so B is the less broken of the two.
